items.title: NYC to Provide Free Art Supplies to Grantees
items.summary: Winners of the city's recently doubled grant for artists can also enjoy unlimited supplies from Materials for the Arts.

items.title: Finding Vermeer in Unexpected Places
items.summary: Artists, filmmakers, poets, and the art market itself still bear traces of the Dutch painter’s influence, writes historian Ruth Bernard Yeazell in “Vermeer’s Afterlives.”

items.title: When the Accessibility Conveyor Belt Jams
items.summary: A malfunction in Finnegan Shannon’s installation at Pioneer Works led to new insights.

items.title: A View From the Easel: Flor Khan
items.summary: “Here, I am allowed to play, to not know the answers, to let the message evolve on its own timing.”
